name: claude-status-bar
description: Three-line status bar: rate-limit bars with reset times, project/branch/git dot, and effort/thinking/output-style.

show_five_hour.title: Show: 5-hour usage bar
show_five_hour.description: Show the 5-hour usage bar in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_weekly.title: Show: Weekly usage bar
show_weekly.description: Show the weekly usage bar in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_model.title: Show: Model name and context bar
show_model.description: Show the model name and context bar in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_reset.title: Show: Reset times
show_reset.description: Show the reset times in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_bars.title: Show: Bars (off shows plain percentages)
show_bars.description: Show the bars (off shows plain percentages) in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_icons.title: Show: Icons
show_icons.description: Show the icons in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_account.title: Show: Account / org label
show_account.description: Show the account / org label in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_git.title: Show: Git branch and clean/dirty dot
show_git.description: Show the git branch and clean/dirty dot in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.

show_effort.title: Show: Effort / thinking / style line
show_effort.description: Show the effort / thinking / style line in the status bar. Applies within 30 seconds.
